```{.r .cell-code}
bird <- bird %>%
    mutate(
        Week = factor(week(Date)),
        Month = factor(month(Date), label=T),
        Day = wday(Date, label=T),
        Hour = hour(Time)
    )
```

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bird %>%
    mutate(species_abbrev = fct_lump_n(Com_Name, n=10, other_level="Other")) %>%
    group_by(Week, species_abbrev) %>%
    summarize(n=n()) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Week, y = n, fill = species_abbrev)) +
    geom_col() + 
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = 'Species', option = 'magma') + 
    facet_wrap(~species_abbrev, ncol=3)
```
